# Vendored tokens

Copied **byte-identical** from the Battlestack Design System export (Claude Design),
export date 2026-08-20. These are the diff baseline for the next export.

## Rules

- **Never edit a file in this directory.** Client themes override values in their own
  package; system-wide changes come from a new export.
- `typography.css` here is the baseline only — it is **not** imported. The shipped
  version lives one level up at `../typography.css`, without the Google Fonts CDN
  `@import` that the boilerplate's CSP blocks. That is the only deviation from the
  export, and it changes no token values.
